inlines.v: PREPOND'ERANCY, n. [See Preponderate.] 1. An outweighing; superiority of weight. The least preponderance of weight on one side of a ship or boat will make it incline or heel.2. Superiority of power, force or weight; in a figurative sense; as a preponderance of evidence.
